heard: NASA threw Voyager 1 out of our solar system. Most think the probe just drifted away by accident. Engineers launched it from Florida on a Titan rocket. Built by JPL, the craft reached Jupiter first. The craft swept within 124,000 kilometers of Saturn's clouds. Planters then deliberately targeted Titan, Saturn's largest moon. They prioritized studying its dense, nitrogen-rich atmosphere. Sacrificing further planet flybys, Titan's gravity hurled Voyager permanently out of the solar system. The slingshot bent its path right off the planetary plane. NASA's plan actually threw Voyager 1 out of our solar system.
